positions.title: Software Engineer - Compute Infrastructure
positions.description:
Responsible for the internal compute platform that other teams use to deploy and run their
code, built with Mesos and Kubernetes
- Developed system to automatically set resource limits (cpus and memory) for services,
reducing cluster costs while reducing developer workload and increasing reliability
- Led completion of company-wide migration of microservices from Mesos to Kubernetes
- Updated service configuration system to allow developers to gradually roll out and test
changes
- Refactored business-critical legacy batch system to use Mesos for running jobs

positions.title: Software Engineer - Ad Backend
positions.description:
Design and develop backend infrastructure systems to support the quickly growing ads business.
- Technologies used: Python; Apache Cassandra and Kafka; Spark Streaming

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built a WebSocket endpoint for a Kafka wrapper service.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Help patients and their doctors better monitor the treatment of skin conditions using image processing and machine learning techniques, in a mobile application.
- Developing an algorithm to efficiently classify images by area of origin on the patient's body

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed an application that automatically builds and serves Debian packages for Google software, for the Compute Engine team.
- Simplifies software installation and image-building process for all of Google's Debian-based virtual
  machines
- Built with Google cloud services (App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage) and Python

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Assessed how the choice of medium affects the effectiveness of advertisements on brand connection and purchase decisions, in collaboration with General Motors.
- Developed a Chrome extension that dynamically inserts advertisements into various webpages such
  as Facebook, Twitter, and Google, and records consumer behavior on these websites.
- Analyzed data collected and presented statistical findings and business implications to GM.
